areas.title: Gateway protocols
areas.definition: Compatibility and translation at RouteKit's authenticated HTTP data plane, including OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses, Anthropic messages, streaming, tool calls, and response metadata.
excludes: choosing a provider or model route
counterexamples: Why was a depleted Codex account selected?
Which model should model: auto choose for this request?

areas.title: Model routing and registry
areas.definition: Discovery and deterministic resolution of namespaced provider/model routes, default models, advertised availability, aliases, fallbacks, and registry metadata.
excludes: subscription account rotation within a selected route
counterexamples: How does the Responses API stream tool output?
How do I enroll a second Codex subscription account?

areas.title: Subscription pooling
areas.definition: Enrollment, quota awareness, eligibility, scheduling, rotation, retry, and recovery for multiple coding-tool subscription accounts.
counterexamples: What fields are returned by calls inspect?
How is an OpenAI Responses request translated?

areas.title: Daemon control and operations
areas.definition: Local singleton daemon lifecycle, control-plane commands, canonical configuration, process ownership, readiness, health, and safe operational recovery.
includes: start, stop, status, and doctor behavior
counterexamples: How do I add a gateway over SSH?
Why did the Anthropic streaming decoder reject this frame?

areas.title: Remote gateways and security
areas.definition: Secure access to RouteKit across hosts, including SSH control relays, peer enrollment, token issuance and revocation, authenticated binds, TLS requirements, and trust boundaries.
includes: remote add and remote use flows
counterexamples: How is the default model chosen locally?
Which candidate won an authored eval suite?

areas.title: Eval-driven routing
areas.definition: Authoring and executing evaluation suites, validating comparison evidence, compiling and publishing routing snapshots, classifying model: auto requests, and reproducing routing decisions.
includes: semantic area classification and model: auto decisions
excludes: general model discovery without eval evidence
counterexamples: How do I inspect the cost of one completed explicit-model call?
Why is the local daemon not starting?

areas.title: Client and coding-tool integration
areas.definition: Connecting and launching Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, and generic OpenAI-compatible clients through RouteKit, including client-specific environment and compatibility behavior.
counterexamples: How does the account pool choose among two healthy accounts?
How is an eval comparison evidence digest computed?

areas.title: Observability and attribution
areas.definition: Privacy-preserving inspection of routed calls, including call IDs, effective models, provider attempts, token usage, known cost, billing mode, account attribution, telemetry, and retention boundaries.
counterexamples: Which account is eligible before the next Codex call?
How should a model: auto classifier decompose this prompt?
